name: Rice (upland)
note: DRAFT for the hackathon. Must be reviewed by a CARI / MOA agronomist before use with farmers.

sms.en: RICE: Brush and clear your farm now. Avoid burning near the forest edge. Get certified seed ready before the rains. Dial *347# for help
RICE: Plant with the first steady rains. Use certified seed. Plant in lines so weeding is easier. Dial *347# for help
RICE: Do your first weeding now (week 3). Clean weeding early gives a bigger harvest. Dial *347# for help
RICE: Do your second weeding now (week 6). Check leaves for spots or worms. Report pests: dial *347# option 4
RICE: Grains are filling. Scare birds every morning and evening. Report brown neck or spots: dial *347# option 4
RICE: Harvest when most grains are golden. Dry on tarpaulin, not bare ground. Dial *347# for market prices
RICE: Store dry rice in clean bags off the floor, away from rats. Keep the best seed for next season.
